proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B C D Q h1 h2 hn h
  have hAB : A ≠ B := h1.ne_right
  have hind : ¬Collinear ℝ ({A, B, C} : Set P) := by
    intro hc
    apply hn
    have hC : C ∈ line[ℝ, A, B] := hc.mem_affineSpan_of_mem_of_ne (by simp) (by simp) (by simp) hAB
    have hQ : Q ∈ line[ℝ, A, B] := h1.wbtw.collinear.mem_affineSpan_of_mem_of_ne (by simp) (by simp) (by simp) hAB
    have := collinear_insert_insert_of_mem_affineSpan_pair hQ hC
    exact this.subset (by intro x; simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]; tauto)
  let t : Affine.Triangle ℝ P := ⟨![A, B, C], affineIndependent_iff_not_collinear_set.mpr hind⟩
  let s := t.circumsphere
  have hA : A ∈ s := t.mem_circumsphere 0
  have hB : B ∈ s := t.mem_circumsphere 1
  have hC : C ∈ s := t.mem_circumsphere 2
  have hD : D ∈ s := by
    obtain ⟨⟨t, ⟨ht0, ht1⟩, ht⟩, hAQ, hAB'⟩ := h1
    obtain ⟨⟨u, ⟨hu0, hu1⟩, hu⟩, hCQ, hCD⟩ := h2
    have hu0' : u ≠ 0 := by
      rintro rfl
      exact hCQ (by rw [← hu]; simp)
    have ht1' : t ≠ 1 := by
      rintro rfl
      exact hAB' (by rw [← ht]; simp)
    have hN : ∀ {X : P}, X ∈ s → ‖X -ᵥ s.center‖ ^ 2 = s.radius ^ 2 := by
      intro X hX
      rw [← dist_eq_norm_vsub V, EuclideanGeometry.mem_sphere.mp hX]
    have hexp : ∀ (k : ℝ) (w : V), ‖(Q -ᵥ s.center) + k • w‖ ^ 2 = ‖Q -ᵥ s.center‖ ^ 2 + 2 * k * inner ℝ (Q -ᵥ s.center) w + k ^ 2 * ‖w‖ ^ 2 := by
      intro k w
      rw [norm_add_sq_real, inner_smul_right, norm_smul, mul_pow, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
      ring
    have hle : ∀ {X Y : P} {k : ℝ}, AffineMap.lineMap Q Y k = X → X -ᵥ s.center = (Q -ᵥ s.center) + k • (Y -ᵥ Q) := by
      intro X Y k hk
      rw [← hk, ← vsub_add_vsub_cancel (AffineMap.lineMap Q Y k) Q s.center, AffineMap.lineMap_vsub_left, add_comm]
    have hd : ∀ {X Y : P} {k : ℝ}, 0 ≤ k → AffineMap.lineMap Q Y k = X → dist Q X = k * ‖Y -ᵥ Q‖ := by
      intro X Y k hk hX
      rw [dist_comm, dist_eq_norm_vsub V X Q, ← hX, AffineMap.lineMap_vsub_left, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hk]
    have e1 := hN hA
    have e2 := hN hB
    have e3 := hN hC
    rw [hle ht, hexp] at e1
    have e2' : ‖(Q -ᵥ s.center) + (1 : ℝ) • (B -ᵥ Q)‖ ^ 2 = s.radius ^ 2 := by
      rw [one_smul, add_comm, vsub_add_vsub_cancel]; exact e2
    rw [hexp] at e2'
    rw [hle hu, hexp] at e3
    have hprod := h
    rw [hd ht0 ht, hd hu0 hu, show dist Q B = 1 * ‖B -ᵥ Q‖ by rw [one_mul, dist_comm, dist_eq_norm_vsub V], show dist Q D = 1 * ‖D -ᵥ Q‖ by rw [one_mul, dist_comm, dist_eq_norm_vsub V]] at hprod
    have ha : ‖Q -ᵥ s.center‖ ^ 2 - s.radius ^ 2 = t * ‖B -ᵥ Q‖ ^ 2 := by
      have : (1 - t) * (‖Q -ᵥ s.center‖ ^ 2 - s.radius ^ 2 - t * ‖B -ᵥ Q‖ ^ 2) = 0 := by
        linear_combination e1 - t * e2'
      have := (mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_left (sub_ne_zero.mpr ht1'.symm)
      linarith
    have hprod' : t * ‖B -ᵥ Q‖ ^ 2 = u * ‖D -ᵥ Q‖ ^ 2 := by linear_combination hprod
    have hz : ‖D -ᵥ Q‖ ^ 2 + 2 * inner ℝ (Q -ᵥ s.center) (D -ᵥ Q) + u * ‖D -ᵥ Q‖ ^ 2 = 0 := by
      have : u * (‖D -ᵥ Q‖ ^ 2 + 2 * inner ℝ (Q -ᵥ s.center) (D -ᵥ Q) + u * ‖D -ᵥ Q‖ ^ 2) = 0 := by
        linear_combination e3 - ha - hprod'
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_left hu0'
    have hgoal : ‖(Q -ᵥ s.center) + (1 : ℝ) • (D -ᵥ Q)‖ ^ 2 = s.radius ^ 2 := by
      rw [hexp]
      linear_combination hz + ha + hprod'
    rw [one_smul, add_comm, vsub_add_vsub_cancel] at hgoal
    have hrn := s.radius_nonneg_of_mem hA
    exact EuclideanGeometry.mem_sphere.mpr (by rw [dist_eq_norm_vsub V]; exact (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) hrn).mp hgoal)
  refine EuclideanGeometry.cospherical_iff_exists_sphere.mpr ⟨s, ?_⟩
  intro p hp
  simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hp
  rcases hp with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;> assumption
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (A B C D Q : P), Sbtw ℝ Q A B → Sbtw ℝ Q C D → ¬Collinear ℝ ({Q, A, C} : Set P) → dist Q A * dist Q B = dist Q C * dist Q D → EuclideanGeometry.Cospherical ({A, B, C, D} : Set P)
